name: Pheid
tagline: A switchboard that routes voice-assistant requests to your specialist bots
description: Sits between what you say out loud and the specialist bots you already run. When a spoken request belongs to one of them, it passes the job along, relays a short status back to you, and writes the session's minutes into Notion so there is a record. Built with in-car sessions in mind, where context drops between turns.
author: monomyth
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
